rounded.$description: `rounded`: 4px. Same as `rounded-sm`; kept for older code.

rounded-full.$description: `rounded-full`: Pills and circles: avatars, badges, toggles.

outline-offset-2.$description: `outline-offset-2`. Gap between an element and its focus outline.

focus-ring-width.$description: The focus ring's width: `outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus-ring)`. Every component's focus ring uses it. A third thicker (3px) with more contrast.

focus-ring-offset.$description: The transparent gap between an element and its focus ring (`outline-offset`). Inset rings, where an outline would be clipped, use 0.

stroke-width-1.$description: `stroke-1`. Hairline outlines and dividers in illustrations.

stroke-width-2.$description: `stroke-2`. The usual weight for outline icons (as in Lucide/Heroicons).

stroke-width-3.$description: `stroke-3`. Bold strokes for large or emphasized icons.

stroke-width-4.$description: `stroke-4`. Heavy strokes for charts and display graphics.

font-thin.$description: `font-thin` (100). Available for special cases (marketing, display type, data viz); not used by components.

font-extralight.$description: `font-extralight` (200). Available for special cases (marketing, display type, data viz); not used by components.

font-light.$description: `font-light` (300). Available for special cases (marketing, display type, data viz); not used by components.

font-normal.$description: Default · Regular (400): body text, long-form reading, inputs.

font-medium.$description: Default · Medium (500): buttons, labels, tabs, table headers, emphasis inside body text.

font-semibold.$description: Default · Semibold (600): headings and titles at every size.

font-bold.$description: `font-bold` (700). Available for special cases (marketing, display type, data viz); not used by components.

font-extrabold.$description: `font-extrabold` (800). Available for special cases (marketing, display type, data viz); not used by components.

font-black.$description: `font-black` (900). Available for special cases (marketing, display type, data viz); not used by components.

line-clamp-1.$description: `line-clamp-1`: cut text after 1 line with an ellipsis.

line-clamp-2.$description: `line-clamp-2`: cut text after 2 lines with an ellipsis.

line-clamp-3.$description: `line-clamp-3`: cut text after 3 lines with an ellipsis.

line-clamp-4.$description: `line-clamp-4`: cut text after 4 lines with an ellipsis.

line-clamp-5.$description: `line-clamp-5`: cut text after 5 lines with an ellipsis.

line-clamp-6.$description: `line-clamp-6`: cut text after 6 lines with an ellipsis.

tab-2.$description: `tab-2`: tab characters as wide as 2 spaces (code blocks).

tab-4.$description: `tab-4`: tab characters as wide as 4 spaces (code blocks).

tab-8.$description: `tab-8`: tab characters as wide as 8 spaces (code blocks).

screen-sm.$description: `sm:` breakpoint, `@media (min-width: 640px)`. Large phones in landscape, small tablets. Container max-width 640px.

screen-lg.$description: `lg:` breakpoint, `@media (min-width: 1024px)`. Laptops and small desktops. Container max-width 1024px.

z-10.$description: `z-10`. Local stacking, step 1: lift an element over its siblings, such as a badge over an avatar.

z-50.$description: `z-50`. Local stacking, step 5. For page layers (menus, dialogs, toasts) use the named layers.

z-sticky.$description: Layer: Sticky headers and toolbars. Use the named layers instead of numbers so stacking stays consistent.

z-dropdown.$description: Layer: Dropdown menus and select lists. Use the named layers instead of numbers so stacking stays consistent.

z-overlay.$description: Layer: The `overlay` backdrop behind a dialog. Use the named layers instead of numbers so stacking stays consistent.

z-modal.$description: Layer: Dialogs and drawers, above their backdrop. Use the named layers instead of numbers so stacking stays consistent.

z-popover.$description: Layer: Popovers opened from inside a dialog. Use the named layers instead of numbers so stacking stays consistent.

z-toast.$description: Layer: Toast notifications, above dialogs. Use the named layers instead of numbers so stacking stays consistent.

z-tooltip.$description: Layer: Tooltips, above everything. Use the named layers instead of numbers so stacking stays consistent.

columns-3xs.$description: `columns-3xs`: as many columns as fit at least 256px wide.

columns-2xs.$description: `columns-2xs`: as many columns as fit at least 288px wide.

columns-xs.$description: `columns-xs`: as many columns as fit at least 320px wide.

columns-sm.$description: `columns-sm`: as many columns as fit at least 384px wide.

columns-md.$description: `columns-md`: as many columns as fit at least 448px wide.

columns-lg.$description: `columns-lg`: as many columns as fit at least 512px wide.

columns-xl.$description: `columns-xl`: as many columns as fit at least 576px wide.

columns-2xl.$description: `columns-2xl`: as many columns as fit at least 672px wide.

columns-3xl.$description: `columns-3xl`: as many columns as fit at least 768px wide.

columns-4xl.$description: `columns-4xl`: as many columns as fit at least 896px wide.

columns-5xl.$description: `columns-5xl`: as many columns as fit at least 1024px wide.

columns-6xl.$description: `columns-6xl`: as many columns as fit at least 1152px wide.

columns-7xl.$description: `columns-7xl`: as many columns as fit at least 1280px wide.

container-xs.$description: 320px, used by `w-xs`, `min-w-xs`, `max-w-xs`, `inline-xs`, `min-inline-xs`, `max-inline-xs`. Small dialogs, popover cards.

container-sm.$description: 384px, used by `w-sm`, `min-w-sm`, `max-w-sm`, `inline-sm`, `min-inline-sm`, `max-inline-sm`. Sign-in forms, narrow dialogs.

container-xl.$description: 576px, used by `w-xl`, `min-w-xl`, `max-w-xl`, `inline-xl`, `min-inline-xl`, `max-inline-xl`. Side panels, form pages.

container-2xl.$description: 672px, used by `w-2xl`, `min-w-2xl`, `max-w-2xl`, `inline-2xl`, `min-inline-2xl`, `max-inline-2xl`. Settings pages, long forms.

container-3xl.$description: 768px, used by `w-3xl`, `min-w-3xl`, `max-w-3xl`, `inline-3xl`, `min-inline-3xl`, `max-inline-3xl`. Article and document bodies with images.

container-5xl.$description: 1024px, used by `w-5xl`, `min-w-5xl`, `max-w-5xl`, `inline-5xl`, `min-inline-5xl`, `max-inline-5xl`. Dashboards with a sidebar.

container-7xl.$description: 1280px, used by `w-7xl`, `min-w-7xl`, `max-w-7xl`, `inline-7xl`, `min-inline-7xl`, `max-inline-7xl`. Marketing and full app shells.

control-height-sm.$description: Height of small controls (24px): `sm` buttons, compact inputs. The WCAG 2.2 AA minimum target size.

control-height-md.$description: Height of default controls (32px): buttons, inputs and selects line up at this height.

control-height-lg.$description: Height of large controls (44px), the comfortable touch target (WCAG 2.5.5).

blur-sm.$description: `blur-sm`, `backdrop-blur-sm`. Frosted glass behind menus and popovers (`backdrop-blur-sm`).

blur-md.$description: `blur-md`, `backdrop-blur-md`. Frosted glass behind sticky headers and sheets.

drop-shadow-xs.$description: `drop-shadow-xs`. Barely-there lift for icons and small shapes.

drop-shadow-sm.$description: `drop-shadow-sm`. Icons and logos on a surface.

perspective-dramatic.$description: `perspective-dramatic`. Strong, close-up 3D: card flips at small sizes.

scale-90.$description: `scale-90`, `-scale-90`, `scale-x-90`, `scale-y-90`, `scale-z-90`. Enter animations for menus and dialogs.

scale-97.$description: `scale-97`, `-scale-97`, `scale-x-97`, `scale-y-97`, `scale-z-97`. Pressed buttons and small controls (Button's press feedback).

scale-105.$description: `scale-105`, `-scale-105`, `scale-x-105`, `scale-y-105`, `scale-z-105`. Hover lift on cards and images.

opacity-0.$description: `opacity-0`, `backdrop-opacity-0`. Hidden but still in the layout.

opacity-disabled.$description: `opacity-disabled`. Every disabled control and item (50%). Set it once to change how disabled looks everywhere.

duration-100.$description: Presses and small exits: a button held down, a tooltip leaving.

duration-150.$description: Default: hover and focus colors, and small surfaces entering (tooltips, popovers, menus, date pickers).

duration-200.$description: Medium surfaces entering: dialogs and toasts.

duration-300.$description: Large surfaces entering: drawers and sheets.

duration-1200.$description: Long loops, such as the pixel loader (1.2s). Decorative only.

ease-in.$description: Starts slow: elements leaving the screen.

ease-out.$description: Ends slow: elements entering (menus, dialogs, toasts).

ease-in-out.$description: Default: state changes that stay on screen (hover, toggles).

motion-press.$description: A press: a control answering while it's held down (Button scales down).

motion-hover.$description: Hover and focus changes: colors, borders and shadows on a control that stays put.

motion-enter-sm.$description: A small surface appearing: tooltips, popovers, menus, date pickers.

motion-enter-md.$description: A medium surface appearing: dialogs and toasts.

motion-enter-lg.$description: A large surface appearing: drawers and sheets.

motion-exit-sm.$description: A small surface leaving. An exit takes about two thirds of its enter, so what was closed gets out of the way.

motion-exit-md.$description: A medium surface leaving: dialogs and toasts.

motion-exit-lg.$description: A large surface leaving: drawers and sheets.

motion-loop-spinner.$description: One turn of a spinner: Button, Switch and the circular Progress while they load.

motion-loop-placeholder.$description: One pass of a loading placeholder's pulse: Image while it loads.

ease-enter.$description: Something appearing: fast at first, settling at the end.

ease-exit.$description: Something leaving: slow at first, then out of the way.

ease-move.$description: Something that stays on screen and changes: a thumb sliding, a panel resizing, a color changing.

text-xs--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-xs`.

text-sm--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-sm`.

text-base--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-base`.

text-lg--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-lg`.

text-xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-xl`.

text-2xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-2xl`.

text-3xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-3xl`.

text-4xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-4xl`.

text-5xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-5xl`.

text-6xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-6xl`.

text-7xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-7xl`.

text-8xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-8xl`.

text-9xl--line-height.$description: The line height that goes with `text-9xl`.

type-xs.$description: `type-xs`: the whole 12px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1rem). Same size as `text-xs`.

type-sm.$description: `type-sm`: the whole 14px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1.25rem). Same size as `text-sm`.

type-base.$description: `type-base`: the whole 16px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1.5rem). Same size as `text-base`.

type-lg.$description: `type-lg`: the whole 18px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1.75rem). Same size as `text-lg`.

type-xl.$description: `type-xl`: the whole 20px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1.75rem). Same size as `text-xl`.

type-2xl.$description: `type-2xl`: the whole 24px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 2rem). Same size as `text-2xl`.

type-3xl.$description: `type-3xl`: the whole 30px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 2.25rem). Same size as `text-3xl`.

type-4xl.$description: `type-4xl`: the whole 36px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 2.5rem). Same size as `text-4xl`.

type-5xl.$description: `type-5xl`: the whole 48px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1). Same size as `text-5xl`.

type-6xl.$description: `type-6xl`: the whole 60px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1). Same size as `text-6xl`.

type-7xl.$description: `type-7xl`: the whole 72px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1). Same size as `text-7xl`.

type-8xl.$description: `type-8xl`: the whole 96px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1). Same size as `text-8xl`.

type-9xl.$description: `type-9xl`: the whole 128px style in one class (Inter 400, line height 1). Same size as `text-9xl`.

type-display.$description: `type-display`: hero and marketing headlines (48px, 600, tracked tight, line height 1.1 so two lines don't touch).

type-heading-1.$description: `type-heading-1`: a page title. What a level 1 `Heading` renders.

type-heading-2.$description: `type-heading-2`: a section title. What a level 2 `Heading` renders.

type-heading-3.$description: `type-heading-3`: a subsection title. What a level 3 `Heading` renders.

type-heading-4.$description: `type-heading-4`: a group title, and Dialog and Drawer titles. What a level 4 `Heading` renders.

type-title.$description: `type-title`: a card or list title, and Card and EmptyState titles.

type-body-sm.$description: `type-body-sm`: UI text: controls, table cells, menus, descriptions.

type-label.$description: `type-label`: a form label (Field), table headers, tabs.

type-overline.$description: `type-overline`: an eyebrow above a title. Uppercase and tracked widest.

type-code.$description: `type-code`: inline code and code blocks, in `font-mono`.
